_comment: Run-dir manifest for eval/viz/plot_epochs_to_degradation.py. Each entry points at a run dir containing checkpoints/best_model.pt and a memorization_gap_eos_best.json (from `python -m eval.memorization --checkpoint .../best_model.pt --mode gap --max-docs 9000 --layout-policy eos`). best_model.pt, not latest.pt, is load-bearing here -- training val loss is noisy checkpoint-to-checkpoint, so latest.pt can land on an arbitrary uptick. Corrected-warmup arms only (warmup_percent, not the old fixed warmup_steps=300). Two series: 'muon_lr_0.003' is the main ladder; 'muon_lr_0.002' holds the e12-e24 arms trained at the LR the e16 sweep favoured.
